name: stackspirit
description: StackSpirit desktop cockpit over a VOWP home

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stackspirit/ui && npm run build -w @stackspirit/desktop && npm run build -w @stackspirit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stackspirit/ui && npm run typecheck -w @stackspirit/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @stackspirit/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @stackspirit/ui && npm run lint -w @stackspirit/desktop && npm run lint -w @stackspirit/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @stackspirit/ui && npm run test -w @stackspirit/desktop && npm run test -w @stackspirit/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @stackspirit/desktop -- --timeout=90000 && npm run test:e2e -w @stackspirit/web
